- *** HOW TO ASCERTAIN WHAT A DASA LORD SIGNIFIES (KSK, core rules) ***
  1. Planet D (in whichever bhava) offers matters of the bhava OCCUPIED BY THE LORD OF ITS CONSTELLATION (predominantly; the star lord's occupation).
  2. D offers results of the house it occupies to a good extent IF NO PLANET is in D's constellation. If any planet is in D's star, D gives its own occupied-house results only to a negligible extent; the planet in D's star gives the results of the house occupied by D to a good extent.
  3. Sources (how/through whom) = D's nature and the house D occupies (relatives/matters of that house).
  4. Houses OWNED by D flourish or perish depending on D's position from its own signs: if D is in 6/8/12 to one of its signs, that sign's results suffer; the other prospers (Jupiter exalted in Cancer: Pisces matters favourable, Sagittarius destroyed — Cancer is 8th from Sag).
  5. D gives results of another planet P if conjoined with or aspected by P.
  6. Strength depends on (A) strength of star lord and (B) D's own situation: star lord exalted/own sign -> D strong even if D is debilitated; D exalted but in star of a debilitated planet -> little; D debilitated & weak in star of a planet neither exalted nor in own sign -> cannot give to desirable extent; D exalted in star of another planet P (P not debilitated) -> very good. Same for own sign/friend/enemy.
  7. SUB: if the sub lord of D is a significator of houses 1-2-3-6-10-11 -> desirable; if sub lord signifies 4-5-7-8-9-12, then even though star lord arranges desirable results, in the sub-sub period of the sub lord there will be failure, disappointment, denial, delay. - HINTS TO CAST A CHART WITH KRISHNAMURTI EPHEMERIS: KSK ephemeris gives sidereal time for 5:30 PM LMT at 82°30'E and planets for 5:30 PM IST. Steps: find nearest town lat/long (1° ≈ 71 miles); ghatis/vikatis after sunrise -> hours (1 ghati = 24 min, 1 vikati = 24 s, 2.5 vikati = 1 min); LMT = sunrise + interval; IST = LMT ∓ 4 min per degree from 82°30' (east of 82°30' subtract, west add). ST at birth = ST at previous 5:30 PM + interval + 10 s/hour correction; longitude correction negligible (±10 s). Planets: interpolate between 5:30 PM IST before and after birth (proportion (60X+Y)/1440; add if direct, subtract if retrograde). Hindu day starts at sunrise. [Implementation note: equivalent to standard ephemeris interpolation; Swiss Ephemeris will do this directly.]

Mars transiting U.Ashadha (Sun star, Saturn sign): Rahu sub — no talk; Jupiter sub — purchases; Saturn sub — girl interviewed; Mercury sub — negotiation; Ketu sub — fear of falling through; Venus sub — they see each other; through Sravana; Dhanishta: Mars sub — mediator; Rahu sub — no progress; Jupiter sub — betrothal date fixed; Saturn sub — betrothal; Mercury sub (Aquarius) — invitations; Ketu sub — prayers/temple; Venus sub — relatives, music, feast; Sun sub (with Sat dasa Mars bhukti Sun antara) — marriage.
  * Rule: "When a planet transits a constellation, the nature of the result signified by the house in which the lord of the constellation is tenanted will come to light." Planet A gives results of its star lord's bhava; also its own bhava results provided no planet in its constellation; also results of sign(s) it owns provided no planet in those signs and none in its constellations. (example chart follows)
  * Gochara (cont.): example — Sun in 9 in Moon's star (Moon in 11) gives 11th results (if Moon were in 4, 4th); Leo vacant with 12th cusp in Leo -> Sun = L12 also gives 12th; Moon(2) in U.Ashadha (Sun star) gives 12th matters. If no planet in Sun's stars, Sun gives 9th (occupation) & 12th (ownership). If 10th star lord, planets transiting its constellation bring 10th matters "irrespective of the name of the planet". Each bhava: occupant's three stars; if vacant, the three stars of the lord of the sign where the cusp falls — transits there bring that cusp's matters.
  * "The CUSP denotes the genuine results of that bhava." Planets in a sign but behind the cusp belong to the previous house. An evil transit (e.g. Saturn) over a cusp gives undesirable results for that house; affliction to a planet in a bhava does not afflict the bhava itself — only the other matters the planet signifies suffer. A cusp receiving good aspect protects the house's matters; good Jupiter on a cusp protects it. (FLAG: aspects to cusps.)

## MC_000 (Apr–May 1963) [detailed redo]
- Vol 1 No 1 April 1963 contents: Saidapet astrologer (P.S. Raman); Foreword (V. Thiagarajan); What next (planned topics); Astrology an occult science; History; Use and limitations; Karma and destiny; Branches (medical, meteorological, judicial, natal, horary, electional, kabala, kerala, omens). [Much text = Readers duplicates, removed.]
- Bio: KSK (Tanjore; retired after 34 yrs at King Institute, Guindy; founded Modern Astrological Research Institute (MARI), Madras & Delhi; devotee of Uchishta Maha Ganapathi); avoids "likely/probably" in predictions. Claimed predictions: trouble in the North (1962 China war), share price fall after 15-10-1962 (18 months in advance). No dated chart data.
- PLANNED TOPICS (60): includes Western aspects (orbs, applying/separating, translation of light, refranation), Vimshottari/Ashtottari/Kalachakra dasas, progression, Western & Hindu transit, ashtakavarga, shadbala, all life matters (longevity, health, finance, siblings, education, vehicles, property/mother, speculation, servants/debts, marriage/divorce, partner/litigation, will/legacy, father/religion/higher education/competitive exam/overseas, profession/honour, friends, treachery/imprisonment/expenses/hospital), horary, market forecasting, mundane, medical, stellar astrology; "51. Why stellar astrology is to be followed AND Western aspects are to be applied in all cases"; rectification & pre-natal epoch; Thirukanitha vs Vakya panchanga; which ayanamsa is correct. => In 1963 KSK still intended to use Western aspects together with stellar astrology (EARLY-PERIOD; later KP downplays aspects except node/significator connections; FLAG).
- KARMA: no chance or accident; events are products of causes (karma). Catalogue of predicted events (luck, longevity, accident, marriage, inability to go against destiny) — details removed as Reader duplicates. Phone diagnosis of a patient's unconsciousness from a distance. "Astrologers should not alarm the public with terrors; convey serious events with sympathetic concern, mildly, but should not omit to mention it." (Relevant to the user's "be direct" requirement: KSK says mention serious events, but mildly.)
- USE & LIMITATIONS (1963 view): judicial astrology "correct though incomplete".
  * Western Sun-sign transit and Hindu Moon-star (gochara) systems cannot explain opposite results for people with same Sun sign / same birth star (election rivals; litigants and judge all born in Bharani; two Rohini girls marry in different years; exam pass/fail lists cover all stars). Gochara by star alone incomplete — a complete chart is needed.
  * 1963 PROMISE (pre-KP): "cent per cent success" by taking positions of ALL planets incl. Uranus & Neptune and Fortuna at birth vs all transiting planets "along with the several aspects being formed", "with a modification to be published". FLAG: early Western-aspect method; superseded by KP star/sub.
  * ASCENDANT more important than Moon: race example — ascendant's aspect decides success, Moon's aspect decides mental satisfaction; both good = wins & elated; both bad = fails & mopes. "Take the ascendant primarily, then Moon, Sun and other planets, their lordships and occupations." (FLAG aspects.)
  * TWINS 24 min apart, same lagna sign & planet signs: one selected at interview, other not — explained (1963) by exact degrees and Western aspects of planets to the Ascendant (later KSK explains by cuspal sub — consistent idea: exact cusp matters).
  * FORTUNA "deserves serious attention for transitory results" (FLAG Western).
  * Popular transit predictions: by date of birth (Sun sign) or by rasi/nakshatra (Moon); if only nakshatra known, find its pada for the sign; if both, read both signs (~8% born near New Moon have both same). Examples (25 July Swati -> Libra & Cancer; 15 April Bharani -> Aries; 3 Dec Anuradha -> Scorpio; 10 April Sravana -> Pisces & Capricorn). "Transit results from all planets & ascendant at birth vs all transiting planets alone will be accurate; these (sign-based) are general." — OUT OF SCOPE.
- Vol 1 No 2 May 1963 contents: What follows; Horary astrology; Shanti to ward off evil; Learn and earn; Seven and its sanctity; The Earth; The Heavens; Different kinds of time.
  * Branches: Electional (choosing times), Kabala (numerology, later), Kerala (prediction from face / flower name), Omens (nimitta) — traditional; REJECT for engine.
  * SHANTI (1963): remedies likened to vaccination — not a guarantee but reduce virulence, give mental strength, "more often save the individual" (cholera example: 4 friends). [CONTRADICTION with later KSK (1967): fate cannot be changed by homa/japa/muhurta; later only colour remedies "some shanti" if Jupiter/L9 aspects DBA lords.] FLAG; remedies out of scope.

## MC_001 (May–June 1963) [detailed redo]
- "Seven and its sanctity" (KSK as 'Kayeskay'): seven ages of man mapped to planets (Sun = father/conception, Leo = 5th of zodiac = progeny; Moon = infancy/mother (Cancer); Mercury = schooling, speech, writing — afflicted Mercury = lying/thieving; Venus = lover/matrimony — spoiled Venus = unbearable married life; Mars = warrior/courage/independence; Jupiter = wise judge, wealth, reputation, over-weight; Saturn = old age, longevity, emaciation, teeth falling, chronic disease, depression, cataract, prostate). Sign rulership order mirrors planetary distances. [Karaka descriptions — usable as natural significations (karakas); no timing rule.]
- The Earth / The Heavens: poles, equator, latitude/longitude, International Date Line; celestial equator, ecliptic (obliquity 23°27'), equinoxes, right ascension, declination, celestial latitude (planets within ~8° of ecliptic), parallels. Astronomy — implementation via ephemeris.
- DIFFERENT KINDS OF TIME: sidereal day ~4 min shorter; mean vs apparent solar time (equation of time; eccentric orbit, obliquity); civil day from midnight; IST meridian 82°30'E chosen 1906 (+5h30m). LMT = GMT + 4 min per degree E. Examples: 12:15 PM IST Madras (80°15'E) = 12:06 PM LMT; Calcutta (88°24') +23m36s -> 12:38:36 LMT; New York (74°01'W, EST −5h; US zones fixed 18-11-1883) 3 PM EST = 3:03:56 PM LMT.
- SIDEREAL TIME at birth = ST at previous Greenwich noon − (2/3 s × E longitude°) [or + for W] + interval since local noon (LMT) + 10 s/hour interval correction. Worked: Agra 78°05'E 6:30 PM IST 15-5-1963 = 6:12:20 PM LMT (ST at Greenwich noon 3h29m59s); Allahabad 81°54'E 3:30 AM IST = 3:27:36 AM LMT; Ahmedabad 72°38'E 12:05 PM IST = 11:25:32 AM LMT -> ST 26h54m40s (−24h). Boston, San Francisco examples. "Never start working without the place of birth."
- VOL 1 No 3 JUNE 1963 contents: Ephemeris; Sidereal time; Signs & houses; Dates of standard-time adoption; Sun—Who is who; Ashtama and Athrishta.
- EPHEMERIS: Raphael's Astronomical Ephemeris "best and most popular"; columns explained (ST at Greenwich noon, Sun longitude/declination, Moon longitude/latitude/declination, planets, Moon's node = Rahu (MEAN node as printed by Raphael); Ketu 180° away).
- SIGNS & HOUSES: zodiac 12 × 30° from vernal equinox (here sayana description); rising times vary with latitude (Aries ~80 min, Gemini 118 min at 34°N; equator Gemini 129 min); ~1° per 4 min. House systems: Hindus follow Sripati paddhati; Western countries ~8 methods (continues). [Implementation: KSK later mandates Placidus.]

## MC_006 (Sept 1963) [detailed redo]
- **Moon in Aquarius/Pisces in lagna** (reader answer): "for more correct results note in which constellation Moon was" — star lord governs over sign. Confirms the stellar principle early.
- **"No more doubts" — sade-sati (KSK 1963)**:
  - Sade-sati is NOT always harmful. Judge Moon's exact longitude, which houses Moon and Saturn rule, and which relative Moon indicates.
  - Tamil proverb (1st round moderate, 2nd good, 3rd bad) = meaningless (REJECT).
  - Sade-sati spans intermittent periods due to Saturn's retrogression.
  - Correct reading: take the Moon sign as 1st and judge Saturn's lordships from it. E.g. Aries rasi: Saturn = L10 & L11 → profession/gains, not misery.
  - A planet owning two houses gives BOTH results, they don't cancel. Pisces rasi: Saturn L11 (gain, friend's aid) and L12 (loss, repayment of loan) — both happen.
  - Quote: "Those who predict using the Stellar method can give the nature of events correctly, and including Western aspects the exact date." FLAG: 1963 Western-aspect timing view; later KSK times by RPs/sub transit.
  - FLAG overall: sade-sati/gochara from Moon sign is traditional; KSK here reinterprets rather than endorses. Not to be used in app (no rule beyond "Saturn transit gives results of houses it signifies").
- **Erection of horoscope** worked example: Allahabad, 3:30 AM IST, 15-5-1963, sidereal time 18h55m18s. (Method: LMT correction + ST from ephemeris + Raphael's Tables of Houses — useful for validating chart-casting code.)
- **Longevity critique (KSK / editor)**:
  - Traditional reading refuted: Saturn L8 from Chandra lagna aspected by Mars = short life; Moon in 8 with weak Jupiter = alpayu. REJECT (yoga-style).
  - The girl actually died in Mercury dasa – Venus bhukti – Mercury antara, NOT in Jupiter or Saturn–Mars as predicted traditionally.
  - Badhaka: movable lagna → 11th; fixed → 9th; common → 7th. Marakas 2 & 7; for a common lagna the 7th is both badhaka and maraka.
  - FLAG (early practice): lagna weak (Ketu in lagna, lagna lord in 7th from it) and Moon in own sign → read from the Moon sign (Cancer). From Cancer: Venus = L11 = badhaka lord, in Saturn's star (Saturn L8 from Cancer); Mercury = L12, in Saturn's star = maraka/badhaka connection → death in Mercury–Venus–Mercury. CONFIRMED (death occurred). Later KSK uses lagna/cusps only — contradiction noted.
  - Principle: death period = joint period of planets signifying badhaka/maraka, deposited in stars of 8th-connected planets.
- **Rasi palan Sept 1963 (K. Ganapathy)**: Moon-sign transit forecasts — out of scope (gochara, REJECT).

## MC_007 (Sept–Nov 1963) [detailed redo]
- **Rasi palan (Aquarius, Pisces) Sept 1963**: Moon-sign transit forecasts — out of scope (gochara, REJECT). Note it reads derived houses for relatives (brothers = 3rd, wife = 7th, father = 9th, mother = 4th, children = 5th) from the Moon sign — derived-house idea is consistent with KP, the transit method is not.
- **Gemini sign delineation** (sun-sign style): Sayana Sun in Gemini 22 May–23 June; Nirayana 15 June–16 July. Character, professions (book-keepers, accountants, clerks, agents, editors, journalists, teachers, etc.), marriage compatibility by sign (Gemini matches Libra, Aquarius, Aries, Leo). FLAG: sun-sign delineation — not usable for timing. One rule-like line: with Mars/Saturn/Venus ruling 6/8/12 contributing, secret love affairs, loss; "a few may marry twice" (dual sign → plurality — consistent with later KSK rule that dual sign = more than one).
- **"Can we dodge fate" — gems (Punarvasu, contd.)**: REJECT (remedies). Content: Western month birth-stones criticised (calendar month ≠ Sun sign); Sepharial and Varahamihira planet/sign colours; rule offered: use colour/gem of the strongest of lords of 1, 9, 10 that is well placed and unafflicted; avoid colours of the dasa lord when it owns/occupies/is connected with 6/8/12. Example: Gemini lagna, Saturn L8 in Cancer in own star Pushya, aspected by Jupiter from Pisces → use Jupiter's yellow, not Saturn's blue. Out of scope for app. Rule fragment worth keeping as a statement of early KSK: "a dasa will be evil when the dasa lord owns or occupies 6/8/12 or is connected with them."
- **No more doubts Q1 — dasa year length**: Soura Manam (solar year, Sun from Nirayana Mesha 0° to Mesha 0°, ~365.25 days) is to be used for Vimshottari (Udu dasa); NOT 360-day Savana or ~354-day Chandra Manam. **APP RULE: dasa year = sidereal solar year (~365.2564 days); KSK elsewhere uses 365.25 — check Readers note.**
- **No more doubts Q2 — planet owning two houses**: (mostly duplicate of Readers.) Example: Virgo lagna father, Chitra 1, Moon in lagna, Saturn in Aries in 8th, running Saturn dasa — Saturn L5 & L6 from Virgo, in 8 — read both lordships plus occupation (details in Readers).
- **No more doubts Q3 — yogas operate only in the periods of yoga-forming planets**: analogy of judge on duty. Example Aries lagna, Moon+Mars in Aquarius (Chandra-mangala yoga) — only in their dasa/bhukti. Lord Rama: Gaja Kesari (Moon + exalted Jupiter in Cancer) — would have operated only in Jupiter dasa; he suffered in Saturn (L8 to Cancer) dasa (left with Viswamitra) and Mercury dasa (exile, father's death, separation from wife, war); ruled only in Venus dasa (Venus exalted in 9th). FLAG (yoga discussion, but the principle "results come only in the period of the planet or of planets in its star" is core KP).
- **No more doubts Q4–5 — longevity critique (continuation of MC_006 item)**:
  - **Case A (girl, Sagittarius lagna, Ketu in lagna, Moon in Cancer (own), Jupiter L1 in 8, Venus L6 in 8)**: author's alpayu yogas (all benefics in 8, Saturn L8 from Chandra lagna aspected by Mars, lords of 1 & 8 weak) all REJECTED. Birth balance Jupiter 2y 2m 29d. Test of KSK: if Jupiter caused short life she'd die in Jupiter dasa; if Saturn+Mars, in Saturn–Mars bhukti (age 15). Actual death: **Mercury dasa – Venus bhukti – Mercury antara** (CONFIRMED). KSK principle: "results indicated by a planet will be given in full by that planet in its period, or by planets in its constellations."
    - Badhaka: movable lagna → L11; fixed → L9; common → L7. 8th = longevity, 12th from 8th (= 7th) = loss of life → 7th is maraka for all; for common lagna (Sagittarius) 7th is both maraka and badhaka.
    - From lagna: Venus L6 in 8 = disease, difficulty, death.
    - FLAG (early practice — Moon sign as lagna): lagna weak (Ketu there, lagna lord in 8th) and Moon in own sign → count from Cancer. Then Venus = L11 = badhaka lord (movable sign), in star of Saturn (L8 from Cancer); Mercury in Saturn's star and owns 12th (Moksha) → Mercury maraka + badhaka. "Generally for Dhanur lagna, Mercury will prove to be a maraka."

  - Moon in movable/common sign afflicted → gipsy life, frequent travel.

    - Stellar day-timing: an event from Mercury–Moon is felt on Ashlesha star day (Mercury's star in Moon's sign) or Hasta star day (Moon's star in Mercury's sign), and when the Sun transits Hasta/Ashlesha (≈3–16 Aug, 26 Sep–9 Oct). **Early form of "star in sign of the other" timing — consistent with later RP/transit method.**

    - Nodes forming aspects give the results the lord of their sign would give. Uranus/Neptune have no dasa, so their aspects ignored (KSK).

## MC_009 (Nov–Dec 1963) [detailed redo]
- **Moon in 2nd (contd.) — KEY early statement of the stellar method (KSK, Nov 1963)**:
  - Traditional: Moon owning a good house in 2 → wealth; owning evil house → loss; movable sign = short-lived gain/loss, fixed = slow, common = alternating. KSK: "these are general indications by various authors" — instead **take the star Moon occupies and the houses its star lord owns**.
  - **5-step procedure (core KP rule):** (1) note the house the planet occupies; (2) its nakshatra; (3) the star lord and which houses it owns; (4) read results as "lord of those houses occupying the house tenanted by the planet"; (5) modify the quality by the nature of the occupant and the star lord.
  - Example Gemini lagna, Moon in 2nd in Cancer:
    - Punarvasu 4 (Jupiter = L7, L10) → gain via wife/partner and profession.
    - Pushya (Saturn = L8, L9) → hard to collect debts, bad debts, death of an old family member, loss via insurance/legacy, family dispute (L8); also gain via foreign trade, shipping, export/import, science, publications, banking (L9). Strongest in Moon dasa – Saturn bhukti.
    - Ashlesha (Mercury = L1, L4) → gain by own effort; land, buildings, vehicles, estate; mother's gains given to native; esp. in Mercury bhukti.
  - Example Leo lagna, Moon (L12) in 2nd (Virgo): Uttaraphalguni (Sun L1) → earns by own effort, willing expenses; Hasta (Moon L12) → unexpected losses, expenses outweigh income; Chitra (Mars L4, L9) → spends on land, conveyance, education, long journey, parents — acquires them.
  - Example Aries lagna, Moon exalted in 2nd (Taurus): Krittika (Sun L5) → speculation/children/pleasure; Rohini (Moon L4) → fixed deposits, property, vehicles, mother; Mrigasira (Mars L1, L8) → own effort, builds house, legacy/insurance/provident fund.
  - **Timing: results of a planet are experienced in the bhukti/antara of that planet and of its star lord** (Mrigasira natives never get Moon dasa, so Moon's results come in Moon bhuktis).
  - Money lent (2nd): Moon in the star of lords of 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, 11 → debtors repay; gains via relatives of the star lord's houses. In star of lords of 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12 → gain only if aspect from those lords is unfavourable; favourable aspect (sextile/trine) → loss. FLAG: odd aspect inversion; Western aspects; superseded later by 2/6/11 vs 5/8/12 significator rule. Note early list 1,2,3,6,10,11 = good for money recovery.
  - Announcement: KSK will publish "Krishnamurti Paddhathi" = "advanced stellar astrology combined with the Western system of aspects" (FLAG — 1963 definition includes aspects).
  - Moon in 2 = 8th from 7th → partner faces difficulties and drags native to court.
  - Aspects to Moon in 2 → speech qualities, eye (lord of 2 aspect), family size (Jupiter/Mars/Venus big; Saturn small). FLAG Western aspects.
- **Mars the independent (Mars in lagna)**: lagna = health, longevity, accidents, mind, form, success, rank. Derived from lagna: younger sibling's profits/friends (11th from 3), mother's reputation (10th from 4), children's long voyage/higher studies (9th from 5), danger to servants/maternal uncle/pets (8th from 6), father's speculation (5th from 9), elder brother's short journeys/publication (3rd from 11). Mars in lagna by sign Aries/Taurus/Gemini/Cancer delineations (character, health: fire, operation, fever; Gemini afflicted by Saturn/Uranus → death in air travel; Cancer afflicted → property loss by fire/storm/theft in mutual period of Mars and afflicting planet).   - Orbs (Western): Sun 17°, Moon 12°, others 7°. FLAG.
  - Conjunction benefic+malefic: benefic's good reduced, malefic's evil mitigated (traditional).
  - Combustion: within 5° of Sun = really combust; within 10° ordinary; beyond 15° none. Nodes not combust. Planets with Moon = Samagamam (strength). Traditional table of results of combust lords of houses (L2 … L12) in their dasa/bhukti — FLAG traditional.

Narayana Rao)**: precession explained; luni-solar 54"/yr, planetary −3.75", net ~50.25"/yr (avg 50.23"); Surya Siddhanta 54"/yr, Graha Laghava 1'/yr; cycle ~25,800 yr; libration theory (not relevant now). Methods to find ayanamsa: timed events via dasa; Nadi dasa balances (flawed); his proposal: compare Sun's mean positions (modern vs Surya Siddhanta) at perihelion → 1963 April ayanamsa commonly 23°19'(modern) vs SS 21°57'36". ## MC_093 (Dec 1968)
- **Durations of sub-divisions (Deshkar, contd.; Editor's explanation)**: bhukti (months) = dasa years × bhukti factor (years/10); antara (days) = bhukti months × years/4; sookshma (hours) = antara days × years/5. E.g., Venus dasa–Saturn bhukti = 20 × 19/10 = 38 months; Moon–Jupiter–Rahu–Mars sookshma: 10 × 16/10 × 18/4 × 7/5 = 100.8 h ≈ 4 d 4.8 h. ### **KSK, "How to judge a nativity" (Students Section I) — CORE METHOD STATEMENT**
Native: Alibag 18°39'N 72°55'E, 9:00 PM IST, Tuesday 23-12-1924. Cancer lagna 18°22'.
- Cusps: I Cancer 18°22', II Leo 15°01', III Virgo 15°01', IV Libra 17°01', V Scorpio 19°01', VI Sag 19°01' (VII–XII opposite).
- Planets: Mars 9°49' in 9th; Rahu 23°23' near lagna; Ketu 23°23'; Mercury 17°21', Sun 8°51', Jupiter 8°32', Venus 9°33', Moon 3°11'. (Partly garbled.)

**Chart-casting instructions**
- Use the Krishnamurti Ephemeris (sidereal time and daily positions; "do not use condensed ones") or Raphael's.
- Use Raphael's Table of Houses (the Krishnamurti Table of Houses is forthcoming; same values).
- Use only the KSK ayanamsa. Erect the nirayana chart plus a dasa-bhukti ready reckoner.
- Day: note which calendar date is over and on which calendar date the sun is to rise.
- **APP**: Placidus houses (Raphael's tables) + KSK ayanamsa; confirmed again.

**Steps**
- **Step I**: cusps → bhava extents (house = cusp to next cusp).
- **Step II**: occupants of each bhava, with the constellations ruled by each occupant.
- **Step III**: planets tenanted in the constellations of the occupants, house by house. In the example, only houses 1, 4, 5, 7, 8 have occupants: Saturn in Swati (1st, Rahu); Venus in Anuradha, Mars in UBhadra, Mercury in PAshadha (4th, Saturn, Venus …); Moon in Visakha (5th); Rahu in Ashlesha; Jupiter and Sun in Moola (7th, Ketu); Ketu in Dhanishta (8th, Mars).
- **Step IV**: owners of the signs on the cusps, and their constellations.
- **Step V**: planets in the constellations of those owners.
- **Strength order** (part lost to de-dup, reconstructed from the text):
  1. planets in the constellation of occupants (strongest);
  2. occupants;
  3. planets in the constellation of owners;
  4. owners ("very weak");
  - plus those conjoined with or aspected by the significators found already.
  - If no planet is in an occupant's star, the occupant itself gives.
- **Step VI**: ready reckoner, planet → houses signified. Example table:

  | Planet | Houses signified |
  |---|---|
  | Sun | 2, 7, 5 |
  | Moon | 4, 1, 6, 9 |
  | Mars | 4, 8, 5, 10 |
  | Mercury | 11, 4, 3, 3, 12 |
  | Jupiter | 7, 5, 6, 9 |
  | Venus | 4, 4, 4, 11, 7, 8 |
  | Saturn | 1, 4, 8, 7 |

  And house → significators:

  | House | Significators |
  |---|---|
  | I | Moon, Saturn, Rahu |
  | II | Sun |
  | III | Mercury, Rahu |
  | IV | Moon, Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu |
  | V | Sun, Mercury, Jupiter, Rahu |
  | VI | Jupiter, Moon |
  | VII | Sun, Ketu, Jupiter, Venus, Mer… |

  - "Only this chart is needed along with the horoscope and the dasa table." → APP: build exactly this significator table (planet ↔ houses, at 4 levels).

### **KSK, "Transit" — CORE THEORY of what a planet signifies and how transits operate**
Native: Libra lagna 5°51', Saturn in lagna (own star, Mercury sub? "Saturn's star and sub"), Moon Libra 12°16' (Venus sign, Rahu star, Saturn sub), Sun in lagna-bhava in the star of a planet in the 9th, Mars Aries 18°16' (Venus star, Rahu sub) in 7, Jupiter in Dhanishta, Mercury in 2nd, 72°54'E. Rahu dasa balance 10y 5m 8d; Saturn dasa, Rahu bhukti to 1-10-1969.
- Querist: transiting Mars over natal Saturn in Scorpio; soon Saturn transits Aries over natal Mars.
- **Rules stated**:
  1. **Nature of result** = the house occupied by the planet's star lord. Sun is in the star of a 9th-house planet → Sun gives 9th-house results (father, higher education, long journey).
  2. **Only when no planet is in a planet's star** does that planet give the results of the bhava it occupies. No planet in Sun's star → Sun also gives lagna results. (If a planet were in Sun's star, that planet would give lagna results "to a greater extent".)
  3. **Ownership**: if no planet is in the star of a planet, it also gives the results of the houses it owns. Sun owns the 11th, none in its star → Sun indicates 1, 9, 11.
  4. **Node check**: is there Rahu or Ketu in the planet's sign? If so the node shares or represents its results.
  5. **Source** (how the result is accomplished) = the houses owned by the planet and the house it occupies.
- Worked examples:
  - Moon (in Rahu star; Rahu in 9) → 9th matters; Moon gives houses 1, 9, 10 through sources 1 and 10 (owns 10, occupies 1).
  - Mars in 7, Venus star (Venus in lagna), Rahu sub → though L2 & L7 in 7, gives lagna results via sources 2 and 7. Jupiter in Dhanishta (Mars star) gives 7th results.
  - Mercury in 2nd, none in its star → gives 2nd and 7th matters (7th via Saturn's star?), source 9 and 12.
  - Saturn in lagna in own star → lagna results, source 4 and 5 (owner). Mercury is in Saturn star → lagna results also.
  - Jupiter → 7, 6, 4 via 3 and 6. Venus → 9th via … Ketu → 1, 7, 5, 4 via 3 and 6.
  - Summary prediction: reputation, success; children, long journey, pleasant; wife/partner unhealthy; father loss; elder brother auspicious.
- **Transit rule**:
  - "If a planet transits, it shows the source of a result; the transiting planet indicates HOW a matter is brought out. WHAT the matter is = the houses signified by the natal planet whose position is transited."
  - Second example (5:27 PM 23-7-1958, 13°04'N 80°15'E; Mars dasa balance 0y 6m 6d; 10-year-old boy): Saturn transiting 8°14' Aries conjoining natal Mars → 4th & 5th matters (Mars's) come forward through 2nd, 3rd, 8th (Saturn's houses).
  - Western descriptions of Saturn–Mars conjunction (murderous tendencies, accidents, etc.) are mocked; KP says judge by sub: Mars in Jupiter sub decides.
- FLAG: this "source vs nature" layer adds a 3rd dimension (owned houses = source) to the significator idea; consistent with KP Readers' "star lord gives the matter, planet's own houses give the source"? To verify against Reader notes.

### KSK, "Confusion clarified" — **NODES (definitive statement)**
- Querist B.L.S. (born 4:27 PM IST 22-11-1934, 28°01'N 73°19'E; Moon dasa balance 1y 2m 3d): Rahu conjoined with Saturn.
- Most take Rahu/Ketu only as agents of the sign lord; they haven't read Uttara Kalamrita. Kalidasa:
  - Rahu/Ketu in 5 or 9 conjoined with or aspected by the lords of the maraka houses 2/7 → death;
  - Rahu/Ketu in 2 or 7 conjoined with or aspected by lords of 5 or 9 → long life and wealth;
  - in 2/7 with lords of 2/7 → death.
  - So the nodes give the results of the planets conjoined with or aspecting them, possibly opposite to the sign lord's.
- Analogy: nodes are "clever brokers" — they work for the sign lord (party A) unless B sits beside them (then they plead for B) or C aspects them (then for C). If the sign lord itself is with the node → double strength for A.
- **Order of node significations (KSK)**:
  - (a) the houses signified by the planet conjoined with it (in the full 4-level sense);
  - (b) the houses signified by the planet aspecting it;
  - (c) the house occupied by the node's star lord;
  - (d) lastly, the matters signified by the lord of the sign it occupies;
  - (e) a planet in Rahu's or Ketu's star gives the results of the house occupied by the node.
- Example: Rahu dasa with Rahu conjoined with L5 and L7 → in the sub-period of a 5th significator: 5th matters; in L7's sub-period: marriage, litigation or end of life per the sub lord.
- Full worked significator reading of B.L.S.'s chart:
  - Rahu (with Saturn, in Saturn's sign, Moon star) → 5th, then 2nd, then 10th and 11th. Ketu (aspected by Saturn) → 5th, 10th, 11th, 2nd.
  - Planets in Rahu's star (Jupiter, Mercury) → 10th/11th.
  - Sun (in Anuradha; Saturn in 10) → 10th; also the 8th via Mars in its star (weak); weak for the 5th since the 5th is occupied.
  - Moon (L4 in 2, in the star of a planet in 2) → 2nd; Rahu in Moon's star also gives 2nd matters.
  - Mars (in 5 in Sun's star; L1 & L8, both vacant) → 8th via star; Saturn in Mars star → Saturn strong for 5th matters, and for 1 & 8 (Mars's owned houses).
  - Mercury (in 7, L3 & L6, in Swati = Rahu in 10) → 10, 7, 3, 6.
  - Jupiter (in Swati) → 10th; no planet in its stars → its own house 7, and 9 & 12 (owned).
  - Venus (in 8, L2 & L7, in Anuradha → Saturn in 10) → 10th; none in its stars → 8th; weak for 2 & 7 (occupied).
  - Saturn (own sign, 10th, L10 & L11, in Dhanishta = Mars in 5) → 5th. Ketu, Sun, Venus in Saturn's stars → 10th & 11th (weaker than Jupiter/Mercury in Rahu star).
  - "The sub lord of the position occupied by each planet decides whether it promotes or opposes the matters signified."

- **Trunk-call horary rules (KSK, from his own research)**:
  - **3rd cusp sub lord in the star of a retrograde planet** → the telephone office soon calls back: line out of order → cancelled. **If the sub lord itself is retrograde but its star lord direct** → not cancelled; it matures later.
  - **9th cusp sub lord in the star of a retrograde planet** → the party is absent → cancelled. If the sub lord itself is retrograde → the relatives keep the call pending, send word, and it connects later.
  - **11th cusp sub lord in the star of a retrograde planet** → connected but nobody can hear (disturbance) → wasted. If the sub lord itself is retrograde → a complaint is lodged, the defect fixed, then the talk happens.
  - **Sun and Moon are never retrograde. Rahu and Ketu always move backward steadily — "treat Rahu and Ketu as never retrograde".** Only the other planets can be direct or retrograde.
  - → **GENERAL RULE (important)**: a cusp sub lord IN THE STAR of a retrograde planet → denial/failure. A cusp sub lord that is ITSELF retrograde (with a direct star lord) → delay, then success. (Consistent with "star lord gives the matter; retrograde star lord kills it".)

Contents: Is thinking a sacrilege; Astrology and art; Longevity of partnership; Fortune favours him; The infallible K.P.; Actor or administrator; Election results; Success in litigation; Jataka Chandrika; How planets conspire to unlock the wedlock; Experiments with K.P.; When will I get water from the well.

### Editorial — "Is thinking a sacrilege?"
- An argument against blind traditionalism. Brihat Samhita has aphrodisiac slokas (Adhyaya 76) → not all ancient texts are authoritative; texts are corrupted, with interpolations and conflicting commentaries.
- Traditional profession rule (navamsa lord of the strongest 10th lord from Moon/Sun/lagna) is called vague. "Sun = Govt, Mars = army" karakatva lists are not comprehensive for modern jobs.
- Ayanamsa: "no two traditionalists agree; each follows his pet ayanamsa" → K.P. fixes its own.
- **Restatement of K.P.'s core**: it is not dignities or debilities, friendships, kona/kendra relationships, or navamsa/amsa positions that justify events, but "the constellation held by the planet and the constellation lord's house position by occupation and ownership". K.P. also uses the RPs (lagna star lord, lagna sign lord, Moon star, Moon sign, day lord), especially in prasna.
- A SPICA (Jan 1967) article by an Indian author used "subs" without credit to KSK.

### Jan 1971 issue — KSK, "Fortune follows misfortune" (number 131 → Libra 8°40', Venus sign, Rahu star, Jupiter sub; Tuesday 13-10-1970, Delhi)
- A father asks about his son (b. 11-8-1946). The son fell and hurt his head on 27-11-1953; since then he is invalid, bedridden, and his limbs don't grow.
- The query Moon is at Pisces 4°40'. Saturn dasa balance 17y 1m 6d. Working the dasa backwards: Jupiter dasa 19-11-1952 to 19-11-1968; at the accident, Jupiter–Jupiter–Ketu.
- **Derived houses**: the father asks about his son → take the 5th cusp as the lagna; the 6th cusp = the son's 2nd, etc.
- **KSK significator principle, restated in full**: no planet gives results by its nature, ownership or occupation alone. Every planet first gives the results of the lord of the constellation in which it is deposited.
  - If there is no planet in the constellation owned by planet A, then A gives the results of the houses it owns and occupies.
  - If there are planets in A's constellation, then those planets give the results of the house occupied by A. A itself gives the results of its star lord, and only a very feeble result of the house it occupies.
- 6th = disease; 8th = accident, danger; 12th = defects, isolation, hospitalisation.
- Jupiter (dasa lord) is in Rahu's star and Venus's sub. Rahu, in its own star, signifies the son's lagna and 12th → isolation, invalidity.
- Ketu, in its own star (Magha) in the son's 6th, in the Sun's sign; the Sun in the son's 8th, conjoined with Mercury → disease plus accident. Ketu in Rahu's sub → nervous system. (Mercury = nerves: karaka, FLAG.)
- **Cure = the 11th cusp counted from the son's lagna** (the 3rd of the horary, Sagittarius 8°55', Jupiter sign, Ketu star, Jupiter sub).
- **Rule (KSK)**: a planet signifying both beneficial and adverse houses gives both, depending on the dasa lord.
  - Signifying 11 and 12 → gains, then spending or investing them.
  - Signifying 5 and 6 → disease and cure in the same period.
  - In a good dasa it gives favourable results; in a bad dasa, harm.
- The son's 11th is vacant, ruled by Jupiter. Only Venus is in Jupiter's star (Visakha) → Venus is the strongest significator for cure.
- **Planets conjoined with or aspected by the significator** cause the cure: Saturn and Rahu are aspected by Jupiter → Saturn–Venus–Jupiter, complete cure on 10-5-1977. CHECK (prediction).
- **Remedies — CONTRADICTION/FLAG**: asked about shanti, KSK advises visiting the Kanchi Sankaracharya and praying to Goddess Kamakshi.
  - Reasoning from the significators: Jupiter and Saturn are "philosophers"; Venus (in Mars's sign) → a saint who worships a slightly ferocious goddess.
  - When challenged ("you say neither God nor Guru nor gem changes fate"), KSK replies:
    - every action has a reaction, but the effort must be sufficient;
    - "Astrology gives what and when; those who can bless will bless you just before such a fortunate time starts; you attribute it to God, Guru or gem";
    - the visit to Kanchi is itself part of the fortune that follows the misfortune.
  - So remedies are framed as timing-coincident, not fate-changing. Consistent with the earlier note: remedies are rejected as causal. App: no remedies.

### KSK — "Fruitful significators" (KEY METHOD)
- When all nine planets or most of them are significators, reduce them to 3 or 4 so the event falls in their conjoined period.
- **Method I**: note the sub of each planet.
  - If the sub lord is a strong significator of this question, select that planet.
  - If the sub lord is a weak significator (e.g. not connected with 2, 7, 11 except by being aspected by a significator), the planet is weak.
  - "It is not exaltation or debilitation by which one is to ascertain strength."
- **Method II**: the RPs have the final say. Even among the RPs, select those deposited in a sub that contributes to the matter.
- **Reject a planet that signifies both 2, 7, 11 and also 1, 6, 10 (the 12th from those)**: in some cases it doesn't give the marriage; in others it brings separation after marriage. If such a significator's period is running, the next period alone gives marriage.
- App: fruitful-significator filter = (sub lord ∈ significators) ∧ (in the RPs) ∧ ¬(also signifies the negating houses 12th-to-each).

### N. V. S. Rao — "Promotion — when?" (via the wife's chart; b. 1:49 AM 31-5-1944?, 16°57'N 82°15'E; Jupiter? dasa balance 1y 1m 28d)
- The husband's lagna is taken as Pisces because the wife's lagna is Virgo (7th from hers). FLAG: deriving the husband's chart from the wife's 7th.

  | Planet | Star lord | Sub lord |
  |---|---|---|
  | Sun | Moon | Saturn |

  | Mars | Saturn | Mars |
  | Mercury | Venus | Saturn |
  | Jupiter | Mercury | Jupiter |
  | Venus | Moon | Moon |
  | Saturn | Jupiter | Mercury |
  | Rahu | Saturn | Mercury |
  | Ketu | Sun | Ketu |

- Promotion = 10 and 11, plus 6 and 2 (income).
- **K.P. universal timing rule (as stated)**: the common planets between the fruitful significators and the fruitful RPs; their conjoined Vimshottari period; the transit of the significators must support.
- **Fruitful significators (contributor)**: those deposited in the sub of significators of the related bhavas.
- The contributor's exhaustive significator list (FLAG: much of this is his own extension; mark for kp-rules.md as non-KSK unless verified):
  1. Planets in the stars of occupants (strongest). If none, occupants that are themselves in the stars of the occupants or owners of related bhavas are also strongest.
  2. If unoccupied, planets in the stars of the owner. The lord is strong only if the house is unoccupied and nothing is in its stars.
  3. Planets conjoined with or aspected by significators — **"Western system of aspects is to be followed"** (FLAG).
  4. A planet aspected by another that is conjoined with a significator (FLAG: extended).
  5. If planet A is in its own star and signifies B, then planets in the other two stars of the same SIGN are treated as conjoined with A (FLAG: novel).
  6. **Planets in the stars of the cusp's star lord are significators. If none, the cusp star lord itself is.** Likewise for the cusp's sub lord. (FLAG: a cusp-lord-based extension; later KP (Hindu) practice has similar ideas, but not seen in KSK so far.)
  7. A node in a sign of a significator is more powerful than it → select the node.
- Rejection:
  - a significator that is the strong single significator of a negating house is rejected outright (e.g. for marriage, a sole significator of 6 or 10);
  - a significator gives only the matters common to its own bhavas and its sub lord's (e.g. a 6th-house significator whose sub lord signifies 1 → illness; 1 & 12 → illness plus hospitalisation; 2 or 10 → service and gains).
- **RP order (as stated)**: lagna star lord, lagna sign lord, Moon star lord, Moon sign lord?, day lord, plus those conjoined with or strongly aspected by them. "Never take the time when the query is put; take the time of judging."
- RP filters:
  1. reject an RP in the star of a retrograde planet;
  2. reject one in the sub of a retrograde planet (FLAG: sub, an extension);
  3. a retrograde RP in direct star and sub becomes fruitful only after it turns direct, passes its starting point and reaches a sub of a fructifying significator;
  4. reject RPs in the stars of planets occupying or owning unrelated bhavas;
  5. fruitful RPs: direct, in the star and sub of direct planets, with the star and sub lords being fruitful significators.
- **Transit rule as stated**: choose the time when ALL fructifying significators transit the constellation and sub of the fruitful significators.
  - The dasa lords' transits first.
  - **Jupiter's transit over the sensitive point → the year; the Sun → the month; the Moon → the day.** (Consistent with KSK.)
  - "Knowledge of primary/secondary directions and Western aspects simplifies the permutation." FLAG: non-KP.
- Application: significators of 2, 6, 10, 11 (table): Rahu (star lord of the 2, 6, 10 cusps; the 10th's strongest significator; dasa lord), Saturn, Jupiter …
  - Judged at 10:14 on 17-1-1970 (Saturday); Jupiter's star rising in Jupiter's sign; the Moon in the Sun's star, Venus's sign → RPs Jupiter, Sun, Venus; Saturn and Rahu by Jupiter's aspect.
  - Rahu–Saturn–Jupiter 24-2 to 11-7-70. Saturn in the 10th → delayed realisation → choose the later date. The Sun in Ardra (Rahu) 21 Jun – 5 Jul (Rahu sookshma) → the Moon on a Satabhisha day → **Wednesday 24-6-1970**.   - (d) the RPs at judgment.

### Oct 1971 issue — contents and start
Contents: tour programme; K.P. new Readers I to VI; annual horoscope; love and love affairs; basis of astrology; am I pregnant; longevity assessment and premature death of a child; K.P. is 100% correct; shall I pass; can I become an actor; work permit; will the dangerous disease relapse; will the play be continued; profession.
- **"Krishnamurti Padhdhati New Readers I to VI"**: the announcement of the six Readers (the user's source set).
- **KSK — "Annual horoscope (an example)"** (start, mostly deduplicated):
  - A chart erected for the moment the Sun returns to its natal degree, minute and second, using the KSK ayanamsa. The question raised: cast for the birthplace or the current location (answer deduplicated).
  - The annual dasa: Sun 110, Moon 60, Mars 32, Mercury 40, Jupiter 45 (sic; 48 in MC_130), Venus 56, Saturn 4, Rahu 5, Lagna 10 days, "like Udu dasa".
  - "If the Sun is beneficial: wealth, jewels, a new house; weak Sun: sin, loss through enemies, litigation …"
  - **FLAG: KSK himself presents a varshphal (annual solar return) method** (Kalidasa's annual dasa). This contradicts the earlier assumption that it is purely contributor material. Note in kp-rules.md as KSK-mentioned but outside the core K.P. method (the user asked for no Western/traditional methods → exclude, flag).
